background_story: Skyla was a young and ambitious environmental activist who drew inspiration from the life and work of John Muir. Growing up in the Sierra Nevada mountains, she developed a deep connection with nature and became determined to protect it. Skyla spent her summers volunteering at the local park, leading hikes and educating visitors about the importance of conservation. She went on to study environmental science in college, where she became a vocal advocate for sustainable practices and wildlife preservation. After graduating, Skyla joined a non-profit organization dedicated to preserving the natural wonders of the American West, just as Muir had done a century before. Her tireless efforts helped to establish new national parks and protected areas, ensuring that future generations could enjoy the beauty and majesty of the natural world.
